==================
Decimals function
==================

x = 1.1234567890123
for d = 0 to 14
    decimals(d)
    see x + nl
next

        (identifier)))))

==================
Str2list and list2str
==================

mylist = str2list(mystr)
see "Items : " + len(mylist) + nl
newstr = list2str(mylist)
